title: Commercial Property Legal Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant

Are you an experienced Commercial Property Legal Assistant who enjoys getting stuck into the matter work as well as the admin? This St Albans role will give you real variety in a team that will value what you bring.

We are working with a highly regarded commercial law firm that wants to add a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to its busy Commercial Real Estate team. The firm has a professional but friendly culture, flexible working and a supportive team where you can keep learning and progressing.

The role combines legal secretarial support with legal assistant work, so you'll get a real mix of both. The team is very busy, so they need someone with commercial property experience who can hit the ground running and support several fee-earners at once.

The role

As Commercial Property Legal Assistant, your duties will include:
- Preparing HM Land Registry applications (AP1, TR1), dealing with requisitions and tracking progress
- Getting office copies, carrying out official and map searches, and asking for applications to be expedited
- Preparing draft SDLT returns and calculations
- Post-completion work, including notices of transfer or charge and deeds of covenant
- Preparing lease and deed summaries, schedules of deeds and sales packs
- Drafting basic CPSE replies and reports on title for fee-earners to review
- Audio and copy typing through BigHand, plus formatting and proofreading documents
- File opening, AML and ID checks (SmartSearch and Legl), and file closures
- Financial admin, including invoices, payment requests and credit control
- Managing diaries and arranging meetings

About you
- Experience in a commercial property team
- A good working knowledge of HM Land Registry processes and SDLT
- Comfortable using Word, Outlook, Excel, DocuSign and PDF software (iManage experience is helpful)
- Able to juggle competing priorities and still meet deadlines
- High attention to detail and a confident phone manner

What's on offer
- £35,000 to £40,000 salary, depending on experience
- 25 days' annual leave
- Workplace pension
- Death in service cover at four times salary
- Extra discretionary perks
- Ongoing training and development
- Based in St Albans - some hybrid working may be available (depending on experience)

If you're a Commercial Property Legal Assistant, or a Commercial Property Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant ready for more hands-on work, I'd love to hear from you. Apply today or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

title: Litigation Legal Administrator
description:
We are working with a specialist legal practice based close to Hertford who are looking to recruit a Property Litigation Legal Administrator to join their growing team. This is an opportunity for someone with legal experience to develop their career within property litigation, supporting solicitors with a high volume of residential and commercial claims.

The role would suit someone who enjoys managing a busy workload, communicating with clients and taking ownership of their cases. Property litigation experience would be beneficial, although candidates from other areas of law who have a genuine interest in moving into property litigation will also be considered.

Typical Duties:
- Manage a high volume of residential and commercial claims relating to service charges, ground rent, possession and breaches of lease.
- Prepare and process claim forms, court applications, consent orders and supporting documentation.
- Support solicitors with possession claims, forfeiture proceedings and enforcement action.
- Manage case progression, maintain accurate records and ensure court deadlines and daily targets are met.
- Communicate with clients and other stakeholders by telephone and email, including managing calls from the enquiry line and resolving queries.

Candidate Requirements:
- At least one year of experience working within a legal environment.
- Property litigation experience would be preferred, although candidates from other legal backgrounds will be considered.
- A genuine interest in developing a career within property litigation.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of work accurately.
- Confident communication skills and a willingness to handle regular telephone enquiries.

This is an office-based close to Hertford, working within a large, friendly team with plenty to learn. The role offers the opportunity to develop your legal knowledge, take ownership of your own cases and gain experience supporting solicitors across possession and enforcement matters.

If you are looking to develop your legal career and are interested in property litigation, we would be keen to hear from you.

Please apply via the advert or contact Calum at Eclectic Recruitment for more information.

We endeavour to reply to every candidate, every time, but if you haven't heard back within 10 days, please understand that you have unfortunately been unsuccessful for this position, or the position has been filled. Please call the office or send an email to discuss other potential opportunities.
